---
name: "nf-core/bam_subsampledepth_samtools"
description: "Subsample a BAM/CRAM/SAM file using samtools to a given mean depth.\n\
  \"region\", \"subsample_fraction\", \"mean_depth\" and \"depth\" keys will be added\
  \ to the meta\nmap to distinguish the different file generated and therefore shouldn't\
  \ be used.\nThe `depth` key will be added to the meta map of the output channel.\n"
keywords:
- "subsample"
- "bam"
- "sam"
- "cram"
components:
- "samtools/coverage"
- "samtools/view"
input:
- ch_bam_bai:
    type: "file"
    description: "The input channel containing the BAM/CRAM/SAM files and their indexes.\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(bam), path(bai) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,cram,sam}"
- ch_depth:
    type: "float"
    description: "Target depth to downsample each input of ch_bam to.\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), val(depth) ]\nThe meta map will be combined to the meta map of\
      \ the ch_bam channel.\n"
- ch_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "The reference genome channel containing the fasta files and its\
      \ index\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(fasta), path(fai) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fa(sta)?}"
- ch_regions:
    type: "file"
    description: "An optional channel containing the different regions to consider\n\
      for the coverage calculation and downsampling.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(region)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.bed"
output:
- bam_subsampled:
    type: "file"
    description: "Channel containing subsampled BAM/CRAM/SAM files and their indexes.\n\
      depth and subsample_fraction parameter will be added to the meta map.\nThe later\
      \ will be used to set the `--subsample` parameter in SAMTOOLS/VIEW command.\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(bam), path(csi) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,cram,sam}"
authors:
- "@louislenezet"
maintainers:
- "@louislenezet"
version: "0.0.0-df69bf6"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/samtools/coverage@0.0.0-df69bf6"
  - "nf-core/samtools/view@0.0.0-df69bf6"
